knownDeltas: This tranche freezes overlay, disclosure, navigation, and menu semantics as token-backed GPUI specs before the repo ships mounted native focus-scope, layering, or submenu runtime for every family.

Browser-origin concepts like hover opening, outside interaction dismissal, alert-dialog backdrop rules, and menubar navigation are preserved as explicit public posture, but their eventual GPUI event plumbing remains later runtime work.
Selection, open-state, and menu-entry models now stay crate-owned and reusable so later GPUI composites and workstation shells do not invent runtime-local overlay semantics.
nonGoals: Do not treat this tranche as proof that mounted GPUI overlay rendering, focus traps, submenu choreography, or keyboard navigation are finished.
Do not collapse native-runtime deltas into browser-specific assumptions simply because the Svelte implementation uses DOM primitives.
Do not treat the presence of these specs as proof that workstation-shell parity or native accessibility proof is already complete.
